step0Sitemap.rootCause: sitemap:refresh crawls only catalog nav + versions over xAPI and is structurally blind to SPA client-side routes behind an auth guard, so a story that ships a whole page yields an EMPTY sitemap diff. Compounded by two route sources: company.ts declares only info + members and account.ts has no missions, while everything else is added at bootstrap via router.addRoute("Account"|"Company") from nine modules in client-app/modules/.
step0Sitemap.toolingFix: scripts/maintenance/refresh-sitemap.mjs gained a ROUTE AXIS (--frontend <path> / VC_FRONTEND_PATH, defaults to a sibling ../vc-frontend) that inventories both route sources and diffs them, plus a staleness guard that probes HEAD and git ls-remote origin and prints a WARNING when the checkout is behind - a stale route list reads as authoritative and is worse than none. It reports UNAVAILABLE with a reason rather than zero routes when no checkout exists, and freshness never counts as a change so it cannot force a spurious rev bump. Documented as /qa-sitemap Step 1b.
step0Sitemap.knownLimitation: at plan time the local ../vc-frontend checkout was at 17c99c7 (2026-08-26), behind origin/dev, so the recorded route baseline omits the three routes that shipped after that date. Self-correcting: the next run on a fresh checkout reports them as ADDED.
